description: Self-hosted CRM for sales teams working over Zalo. Fastify 5 + Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL backend, Vue 3 + Vuetify 4 SPA frontend, Docker Compose deployment. Open-core (AGPL-3.0 + commercial dual-license).

monorepo.note: backend/ and frontend/ are independent npm projects, not a workspace. Root .yarnrc.yml is vestigial.
